finding.en: During postoperative deterioration, left-sided breath sounds were diminished.

finding.en: Left-sided percussion was dull; these are postoperative documented findings, not inferred admission findings.

text.zh-CN: 入院第3天频繁咯血并早产，急诊剖宫产娩一子一女。术后持续心动过速、氧饱和度下降、Hb/Hct进行性下降。
text.en: On day3 frequent haemoptysis and preterm labour led to emergency caesarean birth of a boy and girl. Afterwards tachycardia, falling oxygen saturation and falling Hb/Hct developed.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 左肺不张、左侧胸腔积血；引流约1700 ml暗红不凝血后仍有大量血性积液。
text.en: Left atelectasis and haemothorax; substantial bloody fluid remained after drainage of about1700 ml of dark nonclotting blood.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 约800 ml血块，左下肺约6 cm破裂囊肿伴活动性出血；下肺静脉下方约0.5 cm异常动脉由膈下进入肺。
text.en: About800 ml clot, a ruptured approximately6 cm left lower-lobe cyst with active bleeding, and an approximately0.5 cm anomalous artery entering from below the diaphragm beneath the inferior pulmonary vein.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 肺泡弥漫出血、炎症和纤维素，支气管凝血堵塞；最终诊断叶内型肺隔离症继发肺出血。
text.en: Diffuse alveolar haemorrhage, inflammation and fibrin with bronchial clot obstruction; final diagnosis was intralobar pulmonary sequestration with secondary pulmonary bleeding.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 结扎切断异常供血动脉并左下肺叶切除，术后第5天出院，报告母婴健康。异常动脉精确起源未由术前血管成像确认。
text.en: The anomalous artery was ligated/divided and the left lower lobe removed. Discharge was on postoperative day5 with reported maternal and infant well-being. Its exact origin was not confirmed by preoperative angiography.

prompt.zh-CN: 哪个发现最能解释异常病肺的供血？
prompt.en: Which finding best explains the diseased lung’s abnormal supply?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 膈下进入病肺的体循环异常动脉支持肺隔离症
text.en: An anomalous systemic artery entering from below the diaphragm supports sequestration

feedback.zh-CN: 手术血管结构结合病理比普通胸片更具解释力。
feedback.en: Operative vascular anatomy and pathology explain more than a plain radiograph.

text.zh-CN: 血压高即证明单纯肺水肿
text.en: High blood pressure proves pulmonary oedema alone

feedback.zh-CN: 大量胸腔血液及异常供血不能由此解释。
feedback.en: This does not explain the haemothorax and anomalous supply.

text.zh-CN: 没有既往感染即可排除先天肺病
text.en: No previous infections exclude congenital lung disease

feedback.zh-CN: 本例先天病变可首次以出血表现。
feedback.en: A congenital lesion may first present with bleeding.

prompt.zh-CN: 若同样出现持续出血，应优先采取什么路径？
prompt.en: What is the priority with comparable ongoing bleeding?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 母体复苏与胸外科、产科、麻醉团队紧急协作，评估止血和血管解剖
text.en: Maternal resuscitation and urgent thoracic, obstetric and anaesthetic coordination for haemostasis and vascular anatomy

feedback.zh-CN: 持续血胸和血红蛋白下降不能仅观察。
feedback.en: Ongoing haemothorax and falling haemoglobin require escalation.

text.zh-CN: 等血压恢复正常再评估胸腔出血
text.en: Wait for normal blood pressure before assessing bleeding

feedback.zh-CN: 生命危险的出血评估不能依赖这一等待条件。
feedback.en: Life-threatening bleeding assessment cannot wait for that condition.

text.zh-CN: 认为分娩后病因必已消失
text.en: Assume delivery removed the cause

feedback.zh-CN: 异常供血和破裂病肺仍存在。
feedback.en: The abnormal supply and ruptured lung lesion remain.

prompt.zh-CN: 复盘妊娠期影像取舍，哪项最安全？
prompt.en: Which approach to pregnancy imaging is safest in review?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 按临床必要性权衡影像，不能仅因妊娠拒绝必要CT
text.en: Weigh clinical need; pregnancy alone should not bar necessary CT

feedback.zh-CN: ACOG723强调诊断收益与延误风险的权衡。
feedback.en: ACOG723 emphasises balancing diagnostic benefit against delay.

text.zh-CN: 所有胸部CT均须等分娩后
text.en: Every chest CT must wait until after delivery

feedback.zh-CN: 必要影像不能一概延迟。
feedback.en: Necessary imaging cannot be categorically delayed.

text.zh-CN: 只要术后好转就证明当时不做影像最优
text.en: Recovery proves foregoing imaging was optimal

feedback.zh-CN: 单例结局不能比较两条诊断路径。
feedback.en: One outcome cannot compare alternative diagnostic strategies.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 孕晚期咯血进展为术后大量血胸，手术和病理显示叶内型肺隔离症出血。
conclusion.en: Late-pregnancy haemoptysis progressed to postoperative haemothorax; surgery and pathology identified bleeding intralobar sequestration.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 妊娠高血压不能解释所有胸部急症。
keyReasoning.en: Pregnancy hypertension does not explain every chest emergency.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 异常体循环供血是本例关键解剖证据。
keyReasoning.en: Abnormal systemic supply is the key anatomical evidence.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 必要影像的延误也有风险。
keyReasoning.en: Delaying necessary imaging also carries risk.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.
